title: Rockstar Games Pays About $3.9 Million for GTA 6 Miami Marketing Deal
description: RockstarINTEL reports Rockstar Games and Miami-Dade County finalized a roughly $3.9 million GTA 6 marketing agreement for Vice City branding at Miami International Airport, PortMiami, and county traffic cabinets.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6: Rockstar Pays $3.9M for Miami Vice City Marketing Campaign
socialHook: Rockstar Games is paying about $3.9 million to bring Vice City branding to Miami-Dade County ahead of GTA 6.

sections.heading: The Marketing Agreement
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games and Miami-Dade County finalized a multi-million dollar agreement to market Grand Theft Auto VI. According to the outlet’s coverage of a county press release, Rockstar will pay approximately $3.9 million for current and additional GTA VI advertising. The funds will cover installation, maintenance, and removal of all signage.

sections.heading: Planned Vice City Branding
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL says Vice City themed lighting is expected at Miami International Airport and PortMiami, along with promotional displays on pedestrian walkways and decorative wraps on selected traffic signal cabinets throughout the county. The report notes that some branding, including a Vice City sign on the Kaseya Center roof, has already appeared, while airport and transport plans previously faced pushback from county sheriffs before moving forward.

sections.heading: What Remains Unknown
paragraphs: The article does not provide exact dates for when the airport, port, or walkway installations will appear, nor does it list every bonus media purchase tied to Miami International Airport and county transportation. RockstarINTEL also mentions separate GTA VI stories about download size, review copies, and pre-order popularity, but this report does not detail those claims.
